title: SessionClient Debug redaction canary tests are missing across all extension-client siblings
description:
Workspace-wide gap. Every extension-client crate (mail, chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata) defines a SessionClient struct with a manual Debug impl that redacts the inner JmapClient (which holds auth credentials). The manual impl is intentional credential-leak prevention. But there is no per-type Debug-redaction canary test asserting that a credential literal does NOT appear in format!("{sc:?}") output.

Workspace AGENTS.md \§Security testing pattern 1 says: 'Required when any new type wraps a credential string, a session token, ...'. SessionClient wraps JmapClient which wraps an HTTP client with credentials — the credential is one layer down, but the wrapping is still a leak risk if a future contributor either (a) derives Debug on JmapClient or (b) derives Debug on SessionClient.

Fix: add a canary test to each of the 8 client crates (7 extension-client siblings + base-client). The test constructs a SessionClient using a JmapClient configured with a canary literal bearer token (e.g. 'CANARY-LEAK-TOKEN-DO-NOT-LOG'), formats the SessionClient with {:?}, and asserts the canary string does NOT appear.

Canonical-template: land in jmap-mail-client first, then propagate to the 6 sibling extension-clients + jmap-base-client. Recommend grouping with any future log-capture-canary epic for the same types (JMAP-sc1b.102 reference).

Spawned from JMAP-wzq9.12 close comment.
